title: Manual Vacuum And When It Is Needed
summary: Manual VACUUM can catch up after bulk delete, VACUUM FREEZE can manage wraparound risk before maintenance windows, and VACUUM FULL rewrites and blocks, so it is a last resort for reclaiming disk. The least disruptive remedy is usually plain VACUUM plus better autovacuum settings.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Manual Vacuum And When It Is Needed.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
